set.intro: A short, closed list of harness options. Every change is previewed first, needs your confirmation, makes a backup and can be undone (also previewed first). Nothing else about Claude Code is editable here.
set.mod.archify.help: Installs the diagram skill (runs offline). The Harness page uses it to draw the architecture.
set.mod.context7.help: Registers the context7 MCP server so Claude can look up current library documentation.
set.mod.impeccable.help: Installs the design skill and downloads its pinned engine with npm (needs the network once).
set.mod.rea.help: Registers the rea MCP server in Claude Code so it can inspect binaries and packaged apps.
set.mod.sdd.help: Skills, agents and /amauta-sdd-* commands for planned changes, plus a safety hook that checks sdd agents before they start.
set.notInstalled: amauta is not installed yet. Previewing and applying here runs the installer for the first time.
set.persona.help: How Claude talks to you: gentleman is warm and mentoring, neutral is plain and direct. Applying swaps the installed output style and the persona section of CLAUDE.md.
set.repairHelp: Re-applies the current settings: restores missing or outdated files that amauta installed. Files you edited are kept.
set.review.help: On: after each commit amauta assesses the risk of the change and may ask for a review before you go on. Off: no review reminders.
set.telemetry.help: On: hooks record which tools ran, how long they took and how big they were, into your own local database (never content, never sent anywhere). Off: those hooks are removed.
set.undoConfirm: Undo re-runs the installer with the previous values and makes a fresh backup. Files you changed by hand since are not overwritten wholesale.
set.undoValid: Undo re-runs the installer with the settings from before your change. This preview is valid for {n} minutes.
set.undoneNote: If the change had downloaded an npm engine, run Reinstall / repair to bring it back.
set.validFor: This preview is valid for {n} minutes.

Paths must be absolute, existing directories (in your home directory or elsewhere, such as a data disk), not / or your home directory itself and not a system directory; they are saved in portal.json in the amauta state directory.
